messages:
aj_support: triage note -> NeptuneAI trial (acct: neptune-trial) can't get admin invites. provisioning finished but no invite email delivered. trial days left: 6. customer needs to demo to execs next week, marking as priority handoff to CS. ticket #74398.
maria_csm: thanks for the ping. can you paste the support link + any headers/SMTP traces? is there a preferred admin contact?
aj_support: support ticket: https://redwood-support/74398. headers show 250 accepted then 421 deferred by recipient MX. DKIM/SPF pass on our side. customer says invites aren't showing in inbox or spam.
devon_eng: confirmed: outbound accepted by their MX and then 421 transient deferred. likely greylisting or internal filter. no bounces to our SES.
maria_csm: ok. @kai_csm please take outreach lead. propose immediate steps: 1) email admin directly from CSM with allowlist instructions + one-click admin invite link, 2) schedule a quick enablement call for SSO and role mapping before trial lap, 3) provide a temporary sandbox API key & quota bump so they can run demos even if invites lag.
kai_csm: will do. drafting outreach now. should we cc AE? ae_sam should be in loop for the exec demo.
aj_support: suggested message snippet to send:
```
Hi <AdminName>,
We tried sending the Redwood admin invite but your mail system deferred it. Quick workaround: add no-reply@redwood.ai to your allowlist or use this secure one-click admin invite (expires 48h): https://app.redwood.ai/invite/neo-abc123. If you'd like, we can join a 30-minute setup call to walk through SSO mapping and role provisioning before your exec demo.
Thanks,
Aj (Support)
```
maria_csm: LGTM. Kai, please send now and lock an enablement slot within 48h. I'll request the sandbox key from PM and mark a renewal "watch" in Gainsight with 1-week follow-up.
kai_csm: outreach sent to admin and CC'd Sam (AE). offered 10am PT slot tomorrow. included allowlist steps + invite link. pasted support logs. :sent:
infra-bot: ticket #74398 status updated -> escalated to customer-success. SLA: 24h.
aj_support: customer replied: found invite in spam folder, accepted link, requests quick walkthrough focused on SSO attribute mapping and demo user roles.
maria_csm: great. schedule confirmed for 10am PT. @devon_eng can you join to cover SAML attrs and SCIM provisioning? we'll do 20m walkthrough + 10m Q/A. I'll draft the post-call follow-up and feedback form.
devon_eng: I can join. prepping a short runbook: 1) verify SAML NameID + groups claim, 2) test SCIM role sync, 3) demo admin invite fallback. will bring a small checklist.
kai_csm: noted. after call we'll send a summary + survey and apply sandbox key (PM says done). I'll update customer record and tag AE for renewal play.
maria_csm: thanks. marking actions: CS outreach (kai), enablement call (maria/kai/devon), Gainsight update + renewal watch (maria), AE notif (sam), support monitoring (aj).
aj_support: keeping ticket open until post-call confirmation. will attach delivery traces if anything changes. closing slack thread for now.
